dz: 总理吴廷琰在全民公投中击败前皇帝保大，建立越南共和国。
de: Prime Minister Ngô Đình Diệm defeats former emperor Bảo Đại in a referendum and founds the Republic of Vietnam.

dz: 科科斯群岛由英国控制转移到澳大利亚控制.

t: 美国民权运动(American Civil Rights Motomery):在阿拉巴马州蒙哥…
te: In Montgomery, Alabama, seamstress Rosa Parks refuses to give up her bus seat to a white man and is arrested for violat…
dz: 美国民权运动(American Civil Rights Motomery):在阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利,裁缝罗莎·帕克斯拒绝将自己的公交座位让给白人,并因违反该市的种族隔离法而被捕,这一事件导致该市公交抵制.
de: American Civil Rights Movement: In Montgomery, Alabama, seamstress Rosa Parks refuses to give up her bus seat to a white man and is arrested for violating the city's racial segregation laws, an incident which leads to that city's bus boycott.

t: 蒙哥马利公交抵制开始,由E·D·尼克松和罗莎·帕克斯领导.
te: the Montgomery bus boycott begins, led by E. D. Nixon and Rosa Parks.
dz: 民权运动:蒙哥马利公交抵制开始,由E·D·尼克松和罗莎·帕克斯领导.
de: The Civil Rights Movement:  the Montgomery bus boycott begins, led by E. D. Nixon and Rosa Parks.

dz: 美国劳工联合会和工业组织大会合并并组成AFL-CIO.

de: Albania, Austria, Bulgaria, Cambodia, Ceylon, Finland, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Jordan, Laos, Libya, Nepal, Portugal, Romania and Spain join the United Nations through United Nations Security Council Resolution 109.
